name: Dark Myu Momochi
source:
Your young kouhai, after she got hypnotised serve them as a Hero of Justice.
She use her future reading power to find the people who intend to do bad thing, and beat them until they are sent to the hospital.
She seems to be tortured by the phantom from her past.
